thread:
Emma: Heads-up — just got a support -> sales escalation from Acme. They want better Console observability for billing: per-tenant/per-route cost breakdown, token-type split (prompt/completion), CSV export, and a link from a cost row to the corresponding trace/logs so engineers can investigate spikes.
Maya: Copy of customer note: "We need to show our product owners why a specific route spiked last week — per-model token costs and a clickable link back to the trace would let us justify the charge. CSV export for audits is must-have."
Lucas: Acme renewal conversation depends on this. If we can show a clear plan + quick win, helps negotiation. They're pushing for something in the next 6 weeks. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Raj: We currently emit per-request events with tenant_id, route, model_id, latency, and trace_id. We do NOT record token-level counts by default (only aggregate). So token-type split will need enrichment during ingestion or a delayed job. Trace link is easy if trace_id exists.
Nina: From eng side — proposed scope: Quick win (1): expose per-route token counts and cost in Console using aggregated data we already have + CSV export. Medium (2): join with traces so each cost row has a clickable trace_id -> trace UI. Full (3): per-token-type (prompt vs completion) requires model-side counters or post-processing. Rough estimates: Quick win 1 sprint (2 devs), Medium 2-3 sprints (adds infra work), Full 3-4 sprints.
Emma: Proposal: ship Quick win as P1 to unblock sales, mark Medium & Full as P2 candidates. Acceptance criteria for Quick win: 1) Console shows per-tenant per-route daily cost + token count, 2) CSV export for date range, 3) values match billing within 2% on sample tenants, 4) basic docs and changelog.
Maya: I can gather 3 customer examples and own acceptance testing. Will collect sample CSVs and expected mappings.
deploy-bot: New ticket created: PRJ-3456 "Console: per-route cost CSV + export" assigned to eng backlog
Raj: Implementation concerns: need telemetry-schema v2 fields: model_name, tokens_prompt, tokens_completion (if available), trace_id, tenant_id. If tokens_* are missing we'll backfill with sample-based estimates which we should flag in UI. Also consider retention/perf for daily aggregates.
Nina: Suggest we do a 3-day spike to validate data availability and backfill strategy. I can allocate 1 engineer for the spike next week. Also flagging UX: CSV column names and timezones need spec.
Lucas: Sales ask: if Quick win ships in 4 weeks with sign-off from Acme, that materially helps renewal. Please prioritize testing with Acme's samples.
Emma: OK — action items: 1) Nina to run 3-day spike (owner) 2) Maya to collect customer examples + sample CSVs 3) Raj to confirm telemetry-schema delta and backfill approach 4) I'll add PRJ-3456 to backlog as candidate with P1 quickwin, schedule triage meeting Thurs 11am PT. Owners: Nina + Maya. Target: include Quick win in sprint 47 if spike green. :thumbsup:
Raj: noted. will post schema diff in thread after spike kickoff.
Maya: Will DM Acme for sample payloads and post results here.
Emma: Thanks — I'll update the roadmap doc and ping legal if any export/compliance items come up.
